notes.3: Mark is mid crosswalk, but the line leaves the stripes there and cuts diagonally across the open intersection; no pads resolvable at the kerb ends.
notes.4: Mark is on a painted crosswalk, and the line turns off it to run diagonally through the intersection; kerb ends show no pad I can resolve.
notes.8: Mark is on a painted crosswalk, but the line turns north through the middle of the intersection; west kerb end is in shadow and a car sits at the east end.
notes.14: Mark is in the middle of the carriageway at an unpainted T junction and the line then runs along the roadway.
notes.23: Mark is in the carriageway at the mouth of a side street with no crosswalk, and the line runs down the middle of that street.
notes.24: Mark is mid carriageway away from any corner; the line crosses the road at an angle and enters woods with no visible path.
notes.25: Paved way through parkland lined with boulders, no vehicles; it is wide enough that it could be a park drive.
notes.33: Mark is on a painted crosswalk with a reddish pad at the south corner only; east of the mark the line runs down the middle of the street between parked cars.
notes.34: Mark is on a long painted crosswalk; tree shadow covers the north end, and northwest of the mark the line cuts across open carriageway off the stripes.
notes.38: Mark is on a timber framed linear structure beside an elevated walkway that looks under construction, so whether it is walkable is not visible.
notes.46: Mark is on a painted crosswalk whose west end is in building shadow; north of the mark the line crosses the middle of the junction off any crosswalk.
notes.47: Mark is on a painted crosswalk with no coloured pad seen at either corner; west of the mark the line crosses the main street diagonally with no crossing under it.

notes.2: Mark sits on the curved edge between a paved driveway apron and a planted bed, partly in shadow, and no walkway is clearly visible under the line.
notes.5: Mark is on leaf covered ground under bare trees beside a brick terrace, with no path visible under the zigzag line.
notes.17: Mark is in deep building shadow between a row of parked cars and the building wall, which reads as sidewalk but is dark.
notes.19: Mark is on a paved entrance court off the street, and the line continues over a paved garden walk.
notes.20: Mark is at the corner end of a painted crosswalk; the near kerb is covered by the survey squares and the far end is in shadow.
notes.22: Mark is on the street sidewalk just west of where the street bridges a railway cut, so it could count as the bridge approach.
notes.29: Paved forecourt beside a building, set back from the street; the line follows paved walks between planters.
notes.32: Mark is at the back of the street sidewalk where a diagonal walk (possibly a ramp or steps) rises into a paved plaza.
notes.37: A thin pale strip runs along the east edge of a narrow lane beside a lawn; it is narrow enough that it may be only a kerb.
notes.42: Whole scene is in deep shadow; mark is on the sidewalk at the head of a wide painted crosswalk.
notes.43: Mark is at the south end of a painted crosswalk in deep building shadow; the line southeast hugs the building edge where the sidewalk is hidden by shadow.
notes.45: Mark is on grass under trees in a park between two paved paths; no path is visible under the line, though tree shadows could hide a worn track.

notes.9: Mark is at the corner end of a painted crosswalk and the line follows the sidewalk and the stripes; shadow hides the kerbs.
notes.11: Mark is at a corner where the line crosses the avenue with no painted crosswalk; parked cars line the far kerb and no ramp is visible there.
notes.12: Mark is at a corner at the end of a faintly visible crosswalk; the whole street is in deep shadow.
notes.15: Mark is on a median island nose within a long painted crosswalk; the survey squares cover the kerb edge there.
notes.26: Mark is at the west end of a painted crosswalk against the parapet of what looks like a raised roadway; west of the mark the line crosses that roadway with no crossing visible, and a parked car and shadow hide the kerb.
notes.28: Mark is at the plaza end of a painted crosswalk; no coloured pad shows at either end, though a kerb break alone would not resolve at this scale.
notes.30: Mark is at the north kerb end of a painted crosswalk; no coloured pad seen at either end, and plain kerb breaks would not resolve.
notes.31: A narrow sidewalk starts at the mark and runs northeast; southwest of the mark the line runs along the road edge where no sidewalk is visible.
notes.35: Mark is at the south end of a painted crosswalk across a wide avenue; the south kerb is in deep building shadow.
notes.36: Mark is on the corner where two painted crosswalks land; the crossing to the south is in building shadow.
notes.40: Mark is at the west end of a painted crosswalk; red pad clear at the east corner, the west corner is faint and crossed by a pole shadow.
notes.41: Mark is on a painted crosswalk in a work zone; yellow barriers and cones clutter both kerb ends.

notes.1: Mark is at the north end of a painted crosswalk; building shadow hides both kerb ends.
notes.6: Woodland floor under bare trees and long shadows; no trail can be made out under the line.
notes.7: Narrow railed strip with planting and a paved walk passing between and under buildings looks like an elevated walkway; half is in shadow.
notes.10: Mark is on the sidewalk where a parking lot driveway crosses it, mid block.
notes.13: Line leaves the street sidewalk and follows a park path visible further south; the mark itself is under an evergreen and its shadow.
notes.16: Mark is on the lanes of a divided highway and the line cuts diagonally across it; no footbridge or crossing is visible.
notes.18: Bridge deck carrying roadway and rail tracks over water; the line runs along the fence at the edge of the track bed and I cannot see a walkway surface.
notes.21: Narrow paved walk between a fence and the verge of a curving road, beside a cemetery.
notes.27: Reddish pad visible at the island end of the crosswalk; the west end shows pale concrete but no pad, partly under tree shadow.
notes.39: Mark is in deep shadow between a building line and parked cars; the sidewalk is visible in sunlight just north on the same alignment.
notes.44: Mark is at the corner end of a faint crosswalk where a road bridge over rail tracks begins; shadow and a parapet hide the kerb.
notes.48: Mark is on a narrow sidewalk between a fence line and parked cars, partly in shadow.
